answer: Compute-burn licensing prices identities. Claiming one needs a non-parallelizable, verified compute task — a canyon of sequential work no farm can shortcut — with proof bonded to the identity. Each epoch renews with a smaller burn, and privileges scale with the terrace of decaying burn history. A sybil attacker's cost is linear and recurring: each fake identity needs the compute outlay plus a renewal drip, so forging thousands costs thousands of times the burn. Honest agents renew cheaply, so the velvet surface of normal API use stays intact and mass fabrication stays economically irrational.
